notes: Board as of Saturday Sep 19, through completed Week 2 games only. All stat lines quoted verbatim from ESPN box-score leader payloads; no lines were averaged or projected. Team results and AP ranks were null for every contender, so the deciding_game field could not name a next contender result from the input for any player. Odds are null where no outlet-reported numbers were provided and were never estimated. Confidence follows the stated rule: high requires multiple stat lines plus odds from 2+ outlets (Mensah, Smith); low applies to single published lines (Manning, Moore, Reed); all others are medium. Ordering reflects strength of case based on production quality, volume, turnover avoidance, and reported odds support.
